The outer range ell<=|k|<=2ell is present at s=0, and three congruence cases cover the central range, including explicit ell=16,k=0 rescue P_5^(4,2)(0)=42/32. Only ell=1,2 zero mode and ell=4 ±3 holes remain. Sampling characters on N-th roots aliases precisely mod N, proving exact rank. Independent Chebyshev Laurent-positivity recurrence checked all degrees ell<=84 and exact Jacobi consistency; the unrestricted claim depends on the complete arithmetic case split.
